state.brief: Develop Seenry design skill for repeatable website quality with optional Jev. Existing marketing candidate demonstrates a full fictional Held site in an inert opening preview and a composition switch. Visitor wants to inspect website capability and install the free skill.

observations.source: examples/jev-visual-trial/index.html and app.js; browser-inspected last round
observations.fact: Large embedded Held preview shows buttons and a plus control but pointer-events:none and inert disable interaction. Separate text link opens the complete study. Caption says Opening preview.
Whole-page hierarchy and footer inspected. No horizontal overflow. Mobile word joining and specimen readability repaired. No new observed type or palette defect.
Composition control switches reading order, install copies, Escape restores focus. No actual motion comparison against a reference recording has been performed.
Linear screenshot inspected for macro rhythm and readable closing, not a matched independent quality assessment.

candidate_interventions.preview_affordance: Make the relationship between inactive preview and live study clear and provide a generous open-study action on the preview surface. Preserve page composition.
candidate_interventions.more_motion: Add animated section entrances and parallax to suggest polish.
candidate_interventions.reskin: Replace lavender, typography and hero layout.
candidate_interventions.expand_demos: Add three more small interactive widgets.

constraints: No invented metrics or customer claims.
No change may be called improved solely because Jev selected it.
Two repair passes max; keep earlier source and inspect changed states.

priority.instructions: Which offered intervention is best supported by the observed visitor problem in `observations`, accounting for uncertainty? Select only an offered intervention.
